visual_brief.subject: A major client SDK upgrade that also changes the network protocol contract
verified_context: Anthropic released Claude API version 2026-10-21 together with new major SDK and CLI versions that send the new version by default.
The new API version rejects Messages requests that include temperature, top_p, or top_k and changes accepted content-block placement and several response fields.
The SDK majors also change authentication headers, typing, tool-runner compaction, and legacy client surfaces independently of the API version.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: What looks like one package upgrade is actually two coupled interfaces being rebuilt at the same crossing.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A substantial physical adapter bridge between two precision machine couplings, with one side being refitted while the other remains aligned.
must_show: a clear migration path across the bridge

candidate_notes.A: Constitution-compliant. The monumental bridge makes the adapter metaphor legible, but the construction workers add narrative detail and weaken the quiet artifact-study quality of the golden references.
candidate_notes.B: Selected. Two nested precision thresholds turn the apparently simple crossing into a second interface migration, with a single terracotta payload and strong central crop resilience.
candidate_notes.C: Constitution-compliant. The articulated joint clearly expresses coordinated migration, but the busier rail network and scaffolding reduce negative space at small sizes.

crop_review.article_desktop: Both nested couplings, the bridge deck, and the terracotta payload remain legible in the 1200 by 430 center cover crop.
crop_review.article_mobile: The 359 by 240 center cover crop retains both interface thresholds and the payload without depending on peripheral detail.
crop_review.thumbnail: At 320 by 164, the terracotta payload and nested dark coupling remain a clean, distinct silhouette.

golden_reference_comparison: Candidate B matches the references' warm paper field, restrained stone and metal materiality, terracotta emphasis, deliberate arches, sparse physical metaphor, and clear thumbnail silhouette without copying their arrangements.
